rules: R3 history and project backups are not encrypted.
Preservation and recoverability take priority over secrecy for historical/project artifacts.
Integrity is protected with SHA-256 manifests and restore verification.
Access is protected by NAS accounts, permissions and platform authentication, not by an R3 encryption key.
Passwords, API keys, recovery codes and other live credentials are excluded from the historical archive.
No backup may depend on a single secret key for recovery.
